name: DesignCraft v0.9.0
body:
## What's Changed
* Swatches panel header like InDesign's (Fill/Stroke proxy, container/text, Tint); swatches go to the fill or stroke in front (blocked by #592) by @moppeeer in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/838
* Object › Fitting with InDesign's shortcuts (Fill Frame Proportionally Ctrl+Alt+Shift+C, …) by @moppeeer in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/840
* Respect Find/Change scope and first-match limits by @sanyamsingh001 in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/845
* fix: repaint canvas when entering and leaving parent editing by @harrisonoconnorhover in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/855
* Page tool: click selects a page; its handles preview the liquid rule, Alt-drag resizes, Shift keeps proportions by @moppeeer in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/862
* Control panel for the Page tool (W/H, preset, orientation, Liquid Page Rule); Controlled by Parent; Show Parent Page Overlay (blocked by #862) by @moppeeer in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/864
* Page tool: liquid pins and resize locks on the canvas for object-based pages (blocked by #862, #864) by @moppeeer in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/866
* Liquid Layout panel in InDesign's layout (Auto-Fit, Object Constraints); Create Alternate Layout in the Layout menu (blocked by #864) by @moppeeer in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/867
* Pages panel: Alt-drag copies a page, drop a page on Create new page, Edit page size; duplicates keep their size by @moppeeer in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/869
* Pages panel menu in InDesign's order (blocked by #869) by @moppeeer in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/870
* Gradients between process colours blend as inks (C 50 M 50 halfway), as InDesign shows them by @moppeeer in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/836
* Page tool draws liquid guides from the rulers (dashed), as in InDesign by @moppeeer in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/868
* Layout: Table of Contents dialog, entry options and IDML TOC styles by @aiongg in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/850
* Control: bound click and drag input before queuing events by @MMexicann in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/859
* refactor(pdf): use guarded shared writing by @skylartaylor in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/875
* Path edits respect locked layers; Properties links open panels when docking is on by @aiongg in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/795
* Images: reject EPS bounding boxes with nonfinite corners or size (#740) by @MarekSpodBiedry in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/810
* Fix overset preflight page for frames inside translated groups (#738) by @MarekSpodBiedry in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/812
* fix(pdf): leave form fields and media out of PDF/A-2b exports (#743) by @MarekSpodBiedry in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/815
* fix(cli): reject --pdf-options that is not a JSON object instead of panicking (#731) by @MarekSpodBiedry in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/817
* Keep a missing graphic missing when it is pasted into another document (#720) by @MarekSpodBiedry in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/819
* fix(geom): decompose of a flattened transform reports 0 shear instead of NaN by @saadkhantareen in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/820
* Window menu in InDesign's order; Window › Workspace with Essentials Classic by @moppeeer in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/832
* Typography panel by @andrestelex in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/881
* Facing pages take their side from their section's page numbers (odd on the right), as InDesign shuffles them by @moppeeer in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/889
* Type menu in InDesign's order; Character ⌘T, Paragraph ⌥⌘T, Current Page Number ⌥⇧⌘N by @moppeeer in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/894
* ui_shot: render every script line so long scripts don't time out on the GPU by @moppeeer in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/895
* Linux: build an Arch package (.pkg.tar.zst) by @ujo4eva in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/903
* Render: wide effect blurs are drawn at a lower resolution by @noah1400 in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/912
* Color parsing: bare CMYK is always 0..100, so C 1 is a 1 % tint by @marcoarnulfo in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/913
* Package: a missing link stays missing, with no empty file in Links/ by @marcoarnulfo in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/914
* PDF: a placed PDF 1.7 with /Version /1.7 in its catalog goes into PDF/X-4 exports by @marcoarnulfo in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/917
* packaging: RPM requires library sonames, so openSUSE can install it by @tydude001 in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/928
* Images: indexed-colour TIFFs decode through their palette by @marcoarnulfo in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/930
* Type tool: a press over a locked empty frame draws a new text frame instead of converting it by @moppeeer in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/933
* Show 100% black as rich black on screen by default, as InDesign does by @moppeeer in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/940
* Type: let a blank line's hidden paragraph mark take leading immediately by @zydvc26s67-web in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/949
* Fix overflow in layout.pages.insert when `after` is u64::MAX by @Silvertree2010 in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/951
* Keep viewBox-only placed SVGs at viewBox size on IDML import by @Silvertree2010 in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/952
* math: cap LaTeX expression nesting depth so hostile input can't overflow the stack by @midasmatterhorn in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/954
* Fix the AppStream screenshot URL and caption by @IanHollow in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/957
* Pathfinder keeps the frontmost object, as InDesign does (a photo intersected with shapes shows through them) by @moppeeer in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/958
* layout.section: keep the settings the command does not name by @midasmatterhorn in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/964
* script.run: roll a failed script back instead of stranding its edits by @midasmatterhorn in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/966
* guard: restore the whole command transaction on a panic by @midasmatterhorn in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/967
* Color panel: the Tint field keeps typed text and applies it on Enter or leaving the field by @guillehr2 in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/968
* IDML: import and export ruler guides by @moppeeer in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/974
* Find Font: a style that differs only in spacing isn't reported missing by @moppeeer in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/978
* i18n: Georgian (ka) interface language by @devius in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/979
* UI: CJK interface text from installed fonts, on the Latin baseline by @con3code in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/394
* UI: Alt + wheel zooms the view at the pointer by @noah1400 in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/491
* pt-BR: complete the interface translation by @WladmirJunior in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/495
* Selection tool: Alt and Shift resize around the centre and keep side-handle drags centred by @aiongg in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/497
* UI: show Tamil, Indic, Southeast Asian and other scripts from installed fonts by @aiongg in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/504
* feat: Add UI checkbox for Optical Margin Alignment (#494) by @mjohnson7cd in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/509
* SVG text: find fonts by PostScript name (#430) by @itrycodinganditsbad in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/548
* Sections: the section marker shows the section's marker text by @aiongg in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/559
* fix(compose): enable Norwegian hyphenation patterns by @AkashBhat14 in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/565
* Swatches: Load Swatches refuses .ase files over 100,000 colors and merges in linear time by @dotCooCoo in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/567
* Blend modes don't blend with the paper by @moppeeer in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/570
* Gradient feather on a group: fade it on screen, and don't hide it in PDF by @moppeeer in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/577
* Footnotes: notes stack baseline to baseline by @aiongg in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/584
* (fix)Small frame wrap for overset small text boxes by @seanth in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/589
* Place: with no frame selected, the graphic loads into the place cursor by @aiongg in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/599
* MCP: confine file access with --automation-read-root and --automation-write-root by @isaac-levine in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/604
* Styles: selection capture accepts deleted-swatch fills by @KnottyDyes in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/606
* Complete the Arabic (العربية) catalog: every missing key translated by @hasan-sdaif in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/629
* fix(index): keep level 3 and 4 topics in a run-in index by @webdevtodayjason in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/637
* Eyedropper: a sampled colour goes to the stroke when the Stroke box is in front by @moppeeer in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/648
* Text: stroke behind fill by @aiongg in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/657
* Word import: bullets and numbering from numbering.xml by @aiongg in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/658
* macOS: open the window on Intel Metal by skipping indirect-call validation by @fabian-co in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/664
* Copy a selected placed graphic on its own, so Paste Into puts the whole image in place by @moppeeer in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/691
* test: make the MCP reconnect test socket blocking on macOS by @haranishi in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/692
* Effects apply to frames with pasted-in content (Inner Glow, Basic Feather, shadows…) by @moppeeer in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/698
* fix: show source paths in the Links panel by @haranishi in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/703
* fix(tables): keep each table anchor in its own paragraph by @noah1400 in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/704
* Text Wrap panel: four offsets with the link button, and Invert by @moppeeer in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/751
* Dialogs: drag the title to move the window by @aiongg in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/759
* Scripts: GREP replacements like `$1` stay literal by @aiongg in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/760
* Radial gradients stretch with the object's box (an ellipse), as InDesign draws them by @moppeeer in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/765
* EPUB/HTML: anchored objects are exported where they are anchored by @switch87 in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/779
* Recovery: an explicit recovery folder never overwrites another instance's checkpoints by @aiongg in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/793
* IDML export keeps overridden parent items by @aiongg in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/799
* macOS: menu-bar commands run at once by @aiongg in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/801
* MCP: render_page and screenshot are not read-only because they can write to path (#733) by @MarekSpodBiedry in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/813
* fix(render): cap the failed-image cache at 64 entries (#728) by @MarekSpodBiedry in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/814
* fix: eyedropper ignores inactive states of a multi-state object (#737) by @MarekSpodBiedry in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/816
* Layers panel: the selection shows in it, images are listed by file name, double-click renames an object by @govindaroyaiub in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/936
* dtd: cap parameter-entity expansion instead of trusting a pass count by @midasmatterhorn in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/965
* Text recomposes when the baseline grid, a wrap layer's visibility or section numbering changes by @aiongg in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/796
* #21: opening or dropping an InDesign file says how to bring it over by @Nmarello in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/824
* Compose: spaces at the end of a paragraph take no room on the line by @govindaroyaiub in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/828
* Text: kerning takes a typed value, and the Character panel has it by @govindaroyaiub in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/901
* Tools panel as InDesign's: Gradient Feather its own tool, two-column layout, View Options, Apply Color (,) and Apply Gradient (.) by @moppeeer in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/925
* A line of text is set when its baseline fits in the frame, as in InDesign (descenders may hang below) by @moppeeer in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/976
* An empty last paragraph isn't overset text, as in InDesign by @moppeeer in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/977
* Gradient swatches on text, laid across the text frame as in InDesign by @moppeeer in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/825
* idml: cap IDML package part size on import instead of reading unbounded by @midasmatterhorn in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/921
* fix: find optical-size fonts named by their WWS family and style (#911) by @MarekSpodBiedry in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/935
* Margins and Columns and Create Guides laid out as InDesign's: link button, Preview, arithmetic on leaving a field (blocked by #468) by @moppeeer in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/937
* Fill with Placeholder Text in paragraphs, as InDesign does by @moppeeer in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/959
* Pathfinder panel laid out as InDesign's: Paths, Pathfinder, Convert Shape, Convert Point (with Join Path and Convert Point commands) by @moppeeer in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/960
* idml: read PDFAttribute PageNumber so placed PDFs show their page by @midasmatterhorn in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/963
* Preserve stored IDML page liquid rules by @sanyamsingh001 in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/972
* Flex Layout (InDesign 2026): containers that lay out their objects, the Flex Layout panel and Object › Flex Layout by @moppeeer in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/973
* IDML: InDesign's default CJK leading model only with a Japanese composer (Western text spaced as InDesign) by @moppeeer in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/975
* Layout: parent-page margins and guides, Create Guides on the current page, ruler-unit-aware Margins and Columns by @soro-82 in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/468
* CMYK blend space: blend modes blend in CMYK on screen by @moppeeer in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/588
* Bump quick-xml to 0.41: linear-time attribute check on .docx/.xlsx import (RUSTSEC-2026-0194, -0195) by @natocool2 in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/687
* Create Outlines makes one compound path per line, so Ungroup separates the lines by @moppeeer in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/688
* Ctrl/Cmd + the + key zooms the canvas, not the whole window by @PiMinusMax in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/757
* Swatches: dropping an .ase file on the window loads its swatches by @dotCooCoo in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/764
* EPUB/HTML: list paragraphs share one ul/ol, and pre lines one block by @switch87 in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/780
* EPUB: the navigation lists the headings, with a title in the book's language by @switch87 in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/782
* EPUB: real modified time, a stable unique identifier, and a cover image file by @switch87 in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/783
* EPUB/HTML: generic font fallback from the font's class, and optional font embedding by @switch87 in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/787
* Styles: name the attributes in the params docs, and a wrong one in the command's error by @switch87 in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/789
* EPUB: one content file per chapter, split before each h1 by @switch87 in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/791
* Word import: table cells skip deleted text and field codes; Normal style formatting is kept by @aiongg in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/797
* EPUB export includes tables, footnotes and endnotes by @aiongg in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/798
* Gradient strokes: on screen, in PDF, in IDML and the Gradient panel by @moppeeer in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/823
* Footnotes: Span Footnotes Across Columns sets notes across the frame by @marcoarnulfo in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/918
* Canvas & Tools panel: Selection is filled arrow, Direct Selection hollow arrow (fixes #437, #438) by @el-j in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/929
* Type tool: dead keys and input-method composition on the canvas by @andrestelex in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/887
* feat(pptx): export documents as editable PowerPoint presentations by @PhilippKrueger in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/170
* Paragraph and Character Styles: wire save and delete into the UI (#169) by @zydvc26s67-web in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/171
* Warichu: hostile line spacing and break minimums can't break layout by @aiongg in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/302
* IDML: text in a paragraph-level cross-reference source keeps its formatting by @aiongg in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/304
* fix(geom): prevent invalid zoom values from breaking ruler ticks by @Ni-zav in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/306
* fix(layout): reject invalid spread rotation angles by @Ni-zav in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/307
* fix(geom): correct pica and cicero rounding at unit boundaries by @Ni-zav in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/308
* i18n: translate the whole interface into German by @dwetscher in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/311
* Text: combining marks that start a run are shaped with their base letter by @aiongg in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/317
* Fix help buttons disabled when on homepage by @crqch in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/329
* fix(ui): Highlight swatch list rows and keep panels clear of scroll bars by @moppeeer in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/344
* Route macOS text clipboard commands through egui by @ironinthesoul in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/349
* Compose: No Break runs and nonbreaking spaces stretch on justified lines by @aiongg in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/372
* UI: no crash on textures past the GPU limit by @con3code in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/393
* UI: the welcome screen's Discord button clears the text beside it by @con3code in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/396
* Fonts: a pan-CJK font's family name decides its font menu group by @con3code in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/413
* Preserve endnote and editorial payloads in text slices by @sanyamsingh001 in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/458
* Docs: explain hyphenation defaults and image fitting modes to agents by @KnottyDyes in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/463
* Fonts: discover Linux user fonts in XDG_DATA_HOME by @KnottyDyes in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/464
* Recover document copies after browser graphics loss by @sanyamsingh001 in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/471
* Moving a sheared, rotated text frame leaves no text trails by @moppeeer in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/472
* Show the first parent page behind single-sided pages (#429) by @MarekSpodBiedry in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/474
* Fix needless horizontal scrollbar in the app bar at 115% scale (#481) by @MarekSpodBiedry in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/488
* Skip .ase swatches with NaN or infinite colour components by @Silvertree2010 in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/982
* UI: document views have scrollbars, and Alt pans while editing text by @aiongg in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/446
* Keep '-' after an RTF control word when no digit follows by @Silvertree2010 in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/1042
* fix(export): reject oversized page selections by @skylartaylor in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/1089
* ci: add nix check workflow by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/1101
* feat(installer): unify Windows setup and completion screens by @skylartaylor in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/1103
* Integration batch: 197 PRs on main by @aiongg in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/1139
* fix: IDML links in a subfolder beside the package load on another machine by @Kerrrunchhh in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/1015
* Window > Paragraph Styles opens the floating Character Styles | Paragraph Styles group, as InDesign does by @moppeeer in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/1022
* idml: one unusable CJK metric no longer refuses the whole file by @midasmatterhorn in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/1027
* Objects snap to the bleed guide by @pepen11 in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/1034
* The status bar's error count opens the Preflight panel by @pepen11 in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/1035
* Overset marks for text frames inside groups (ports when selected; the red mark always) by @pepen11 in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/1036
* Layout: First/Previous/Next/Last Page and Next/Previous Spread, with InDesign's shortcuts by @moppeeer in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/1043
* View: Presentation shows one spread fitted to the screen; arrow keys and clicks go through the spreads by @moppeeer in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/1044
* Keep text of inline content controls in DOCX import by @Silvertree2010 in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/1054
* Canvas: pages show their paper while their render is on its way, not black by @moppeeer in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/1056
* Pages: deleting pages that contain objects asks first, with Don't show again by @moppeeer in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/1058
* Properties: Edit Page takes the Page tool to the page and sets that page's size, as InDesign's by @moppeeer in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/1059
* Styles: show paragraph overrides and clear them from the row menu by @moppeeer in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/1060
* Styles: captured text follows later style edits by @moppeeer in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/1061
* Styles: preview paragraph and character style edits before applying them by @moppeeer in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/1062
* UI: Typography opens with its named panel groups and a clear page by @moppeeer in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/1063
* Styles: redefine paragraph and character styles from local formatting by @moppeeer in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/1064
* Styles: show captured color and spacing in Paragraph Style Settings by @moppeeer in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/1065
* Pages panel: Panel Options (sizes, thumbnails, parents side by side, pages on top, resize), as InDesign's by @moppeeer in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/1067
* Table › Convert Rows › To Header, To Body and To Footer, as in InDesign by @marcoarnulfo in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/1068
* Units: inches show four decimals, as InDesign's fields (0.1667 in, 8.2677 in) by @moppeeer in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/1073
* Rulers: the corner where they meet sets both rulers' units; ruler menus as InDesign's by @moppeeer in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/1074
* Thread the loaded text cursor into a text frame inside a group by @Hamza0101 in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/1075
* Tools: a tool group's flyout closes on Esc and on a click outside it, as InDesign's by @moppeeer in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/1076
* Hyphenate Greek by @Hamza0101 in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/1077
* Color Theme: extract a placed image palette and add it to Swatches by @moppeeer in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/1079
* Fill and stroke with nothing selected set the colours of new shapes, as InDesign's document defaults by @moppeeer in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/1081
* Canvas: Enter and Tab in a panel field no longer reach the selected text by @marcoarnulfo in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/1090
* Contributors: add Marco Arnulfo by @marcoarnulfo in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/1098
* Add A0, A1 and A2 poster page presets by @harrisonoconnorhover in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/1099
* New Swatch names a gradient "New Gradient Swatch"; gradient swatches from colour swatches by @moppeeer in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/763
* Story Editor stays with its document; Undo restores the selection from before the command by @aiongg in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/794
* PDF export leaves out form fields, buttons and media that aren't shown by @aiongg in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/800
* Open .indd and .indt files through indd-utils by @aiongg in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/808
* fix: drop the background render when a display option changes (#730) by @MarekSpodBiedry in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/818
* End the RTF \uN fallback skip at the end of its group by @Silvertree2010 in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/985
* Flatten deleted text variables in table cells and notes by @Silvertree2010 in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/986
* Type menu: Define Lists path matches the menu by @aiongg in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/989
* Toolbar: Apply Gradient on the stroke is one undo step by @aiongg in https://github.com/storytold/designcraft/pull/991
